race.comment: ROYAL INFANTRY (2) missed out on a hat-trick of wins when finishing fourth last start at Horsham in BM70 company over 1400m. He slides down in class, draws the pole position, and can bounce straight back into the top 3 here. Hard to beat. RUSSIAN DUCHESS (6) ran on without much room at Ballarat just over 5 weeks ago, and will don the blinkers for the first time. She is expected to settle closer to the pace here, and should be thereabouts at the finish. Each way. PRINCESS TORO (4) won a jump-out prior to needing her resuming run at Bendigo 2 and a half weeks ago. She strips fitter, drops in class, and can take this out. BLACK ACES (5) was an easier maiden winner at Warrnambool at his penultimate start, and then failed to cop a heavy track at Ballarat nearly a fortnight ago. The blinkers are on for the first time, and on a firmer surface, he can bounce straight back into form. TURNED DOWN (3) will be peaking third up, and the small field suits him. Keep safe in all combos.
